title: Gnocchi, tomato and mozzarella bake
toddlerSplit: Theirs comes from the middle of the dish where it is cooler and milder — leave the chilli flakes off that half entirely. Halve the gnocchi for the 2-year-old.
steps: Soften sliced red onion and garlic 4 minutes, add both tins of tomatoes, oregano and a pinch of sugar. Bubble 5 minutes.
Stir the raw gnocchi straight into the sauce — no need to boil it first.
Tip into a baking dish. Tear mozzarella over, grate parmesan on top. Chilli flakes on one half only.
Bake 15 minutes until blistered. Basil over, stand 3 minutes before serving — it comes out molten.
